notes.title: 【Demo 0.0.8.5】Demo Update
notes.content:
Dear players, it's been a while. This is Zhiyi, and I want to thank you all for your continued support of my project.

First of all, I would like to inform you that the name of this game has been changed from "Lianhai Billiard Club" to "Winner's Break." 
In pool game, "break" means the opening shot, while "Winner's Break" means the winner gets the opening shot. 
Naming the game this way signifies that in this game, our main character, Qi Ming, will make a breakthrough in his life.

I want to apologize for the delays in development that I have experienced due to various reasons. However, I want to assure you that I have not given up on this project, and have been working hard to bring you a complete version this year.

As a gesture of apology, I am excited to present to you the new demo version of "Winner's Break". This demo includes the complete first episode, "Meteor Night," which tells the story of a troubled student named Qi Ming who discovers pool game.

This demo version contains the content of the first episode "Meteor Night".
It tells the story of the troubled student Qi Ming, who meets billiards.
Lost and helpless, self-doubt, inner struggle… 
Facing heavy difficulties, on the night of the meteor falling, Qi Ming embarked on a journey!

The game language will be set automatically based on your computer settings. If you find the language setting to be incorrect, you can manually adjust it by selecting the third option on the title page.

For more information on this demo, please click on the "About this Demo" option on the title page. I hope you enjoy playing the game!
